programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #5
programme.desc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感。他教授瞭如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士、溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #7
programme.desc: 為了尋找最適合國宴的食材,廖崇明到訪色彩繽紛的芽籠蔬果市場以及米芝蓮星級餐廳。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #8
programme.desc: 在雞尾酒會期間,從峇峇孃惹的私房甜品到精緻的甜品吧,廖崇明發現了一些新加坡最好的甜品。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #9
programme.desc: 廖崇明把過去幾週所學到的知識融匯貫通,為包括他母親在內的一些貴客提供令人印象深刻的五道菜晚宴。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明跟堂弟交流他30多年來製作海南雞飯的心得。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #5
programme.desc: 廖崇明前往著名的牛頓熟食中心,繼續尋找海鮮靈感。他教授瞭如何安排一場獨一無二海鮮盛宴的大師班。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明從新加坡動物園的傳統早餐,包括咖央多士、溫泉蛋和咖啡開始,尋找新加坡最好的蔬菜菜式。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #3
programme.desc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量。這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #4
programme.desc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #5
programme.desc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6
programme.desc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #7
programme.desc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族羣,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8
programme.desc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務。

programme.title: 北領地好味道 #7
programme.desc: 達爾文唯一的朱古力師裏奧健弗斯帶佔美參觀自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力。

programme.title: 北領地好味道 #8
programme.desc: 佔美參觀達爾文市中心,給自己的餐廳哈紐文一些建議,並烹製他兒時最喜歡的菜式之一。

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #1
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大另類療法,並瞭解那些至今仍保留傳統的療法。

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #2
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大有著臺灣風味的西餐。跟她瞭解為何這些食物在當地人和遊客中如此受歡迎。

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #3
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺北五間最多善信到訪的寺廟。跟她瞭解各寺廟崇拜的神明,以及人們在各寺廟祈禱的內容。

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #4
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大原住民美食。跟她參觀兩個原住民村莊,並瞭解這些食物的製作方法。

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #5
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大獨特街頭美食。她也嘗試製作一些,並瞭解它們各具特色的原因。

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #6
programme.desc: 祖莉探索五大臺灣製造的頂尖發明。細訴這些改變生活的物品的起源,並瞭解為何那麼多人喜歡它們。

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #7
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣地鐵站五大裝置藝術,並細訴它們如何呼應這些車站的地理位置。

programme.title: 臺灣之最 #8
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大咖啡品牌。她向獲獎的咖啡師們瞭解能在激烈競爭中脫穎而出的原因。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #2
programme.desc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信、最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA。他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #3
programme.desc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運。米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練。

programme.title: 維修的奧祕 2 #4
programme.desc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的「重型運輸機」中隊。他們致力保持CH53「超級種馬」直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備。

programme.title: 博物館的祕密 3 #4
programme.desc: 本週《博物館的祕密》聚焦產業與設計。策展人馬丁準備展出莫里斯・布魯姆菲爾德的攝影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生產檔案,另展出一條佳姆丹尼紗巾與喬賽亞・韋奇伍德的陶瓷試作品。

programme.title: 博物館的祕密 3 #5
programme.desc: 本週,修復師 Adriana 清潔一座唐納泰羅雕像,西蒙收到海倫・米倫在《女王登場》中穿過的戲服,克里斯多福會見設計師肯尼斯・格蘭奇爵士,而 VA 鄧迪館邀請藝術家 Yinka Ilori 設計一座色彩繽紛的迷宮。

programme.title: 廣告界奇才 #1
programme.desc: 且看50年代的廣告活動如何推出新的美國傳統和明天會更好的承諾。

programme.title: 廣告界奇才 #2

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動。座頭鯨還面臨着一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型集裝箱船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘魚通常被稱爲恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界。我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的祕密和行爲。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息。歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴。

programme.title: 冰島: 海鸚保護區
programme.desc: 討人喜歡、被視為「滑稽」的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂。長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖。少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥。

programme.title: 巨型長毛象的足跡
programme.desc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復。我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程。透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #4
programme.desc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #5
programme.desc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6
programme.desc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #7
programme.desc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族羣,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8
programme.desc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中。溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥、覓食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖、魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英里西非遷徙、三文魚返回牠們出生的河流、極北蝰產子的季節。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #4
programme.desc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息。歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴。

programme.title: 冰島: 海鸚保護區
programme.desc: 討人喜歡、被視為「滑稽」的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂。長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖。少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥。

programme.title: 巨型長毛象的足跡
programme.desc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復。我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程。透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態。從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中。溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥、覓食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖、魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英里西非遷徙、三文魚返回牠們出生的河流、極北蝰產子的季節。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #3
programme.desc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量。這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰。

programme.title: Survive The Wild
programme.desc: In the wild, survival is a fight Whether it’s aggression… defense… or avoidance… the strategies of that fight are known as agonism

programme.title: Super Senses
programme.desc: In this episode of Animal Super Senses, we find out more about the animals that have their feet firmly planted on or under the ground and find out how their senses are tuned to survive What we see above the ground is only a small part of the natural world, …a busy, complex web of life lies just beneath our feet Fossorial animals are well adapted to life underground They live in burrows, tunnels, and mounds using the earth, or whatever substrate they live in, to build their homes, find their food and friends, and stay safe from enemies

programme.title: Shark Gordon
programme.desc: Shark Gordon's off to the Sea of Cortez to after his next quarry Dive in and see the wonder of an underwater mountain as Gordon and his crew scour it for the elusive schools of hammerheads

programme.desc: From skunks to sea cucumbers, nature is full of creatures that deploy foul smells or sticky substances to escape danger These tactics often turn predators away instantly

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #7

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #1
programme.desc: 被稱為英雄王的老國王英格利斯為王國和人民奉獻了一生。面臨人生最終時刻的他向女神亞莉絲泰爾許願,表示若能重生便想畢生專精武藝。他轉生為名叫英格莉絲的女性後,在還是嬰兒時就學會凝聚靈素,擊倒魔石獸。 五歲時便能閉著眼打贏偷用魔術的拉哈爾。

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #2
programme.desc: 英格莉絲和拉菲妮亞在六歲時為了成為騎士而參加受洗。拉菲妮亞獲得上級魔印,但英格莉絲卻自願成為無印者。十二歲時兩人前往王都,巧遇天上人的拉哈爾,並在聖騎士里昂的介紹下結識天惠武姬的厄麗絲。深夜時,與厄麗絲相遇的英格莉絲決定藉此機會與她切磋。

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #3
programme.desc: 里昂趕到遭天上人重創的厄麗絲面前,受夠天上人蠻橫行為的他決定加入反天上人組織「血鐵鎖旅團」。巨大的魔石獸突然出現並襲擊拉菲妮亞,英格莉絲為了保護她將其擊倒,然而對方竟是喝下虹粉藥的拉哈爾。之後成為十五歲的兩人為了進入騎士學院而前往王都。

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #4
programme.desc: 英格莉絲與天惠武姬之一的希絲緹亞對峙,兩人展開激烈的攻防戰。對方使出致命一擊,但英格莉絲成功扭轉戰況,擊敗對手。事後執政官席蘭妮赦免了反叛騎士的罪行並宣佈關於天上領的新計畫。她卻因為服用虹粉藥變成魔石獸,遭血鐵鎖旅團的首領黑假面男攻擊。

programme.title: 海賊王 #43
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.desc: 英格莉絲和拉菲妮亞在六歲時為了成為騎士而參加受洗。拉菲妮亞獲得上級魔印,但英格莉絲卻自願成為無印者。十二歲時兩人前往王都,巧遇天上人的拉哈爾,並在聖騎士里昂的介紹下結識天惠武姬的厄麗絲。深夜時,與厄麗絲相遇的英格莉絲決定藉此機會與她切磋。

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #3
programme.desc: 里昂趕到遭天上人重創的厄麗絲面前,受夠天上人蠻橫行為的他決定加入反天上人組織「血鐵鎖旅團」。巨大的魔石獸突然出現並襲擊拉菲妮亞,英格莉絲為了保護她將其擊倒,然而對方竟是喝下虹粉藥的拉哈爾。之後成為十五歲的兩人為了進入騎士學院而前往王都。

programme.title: 英雄王,為了窮盡武道而轉生~而後成為世界最強見習騎士♀~ #4
programme.desc: 英格莉絲與天惠武姬之一的希絲緹亞對峙,兩人展開激烈的攻防戰。對方使出致命一擊,但英格莉絲成功扭轉戰況,擊敗對手。事後執政官席蘭妮赦免了反叛騎士的罪行並宣佈關於天上領的新計畫。她卻因為服用虹粉藥變成魔石獸,遭血鐵鎖旅團的首領黑假面男攻擊。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #12
programme.desc: 隨著夏天的結束,高地半獸人在探索森林時遭到狼和熊的攻擊。誠尋求平靜,但遇到的熊卻對他表現出敵意。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #13
programme.desc: 隨著學校祭典的臨近,信仰女神的神殿準祭司西耐來找真。她告訴真,葛之葉商會所販售的藥品在市面上有不好的傳聞。西耐提出,如果真能向神殿公開藥品的製作過程,神殿就會協助消除這些謠言。真對這個建議。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #14
programme.desc: 校慶第二天,真受邀參加學生和來賓聚餐的宴會, 洛雷爾聯邦的重要人物彩律來向他搭話。她懷疑真是從異世界來的人。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #12
programme.desc: 經過梅爾努力不懈的調查,聖女的祕密終於揭曉,而祕密與學校扭曲的現況有深刻的關聯。身為監督者,為了引導聖女踏上正途,反派千金艾莉西亞終於與真女主麗茲展開正面對決。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #13
programme.desc: 杜克冷冷地對艾莉西亞吐出一句「你是誰?」。似乎有人對杜克施了消除記憶的魔法,而嫌疑落到了艾莉西亞的頭上。她被傳喚到王宮裡,最終會面臨什麼樣的命運呢?

programme.title: 海賊王 #43
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #24
programme.desc: 兩隊迎來先贏得兩分便是贏家的局面,在差1分就能定勝負的緊張情況下雙方持續交手。 一行人面對稻荷崎展開激鬥,兩方隊伍都將整體的戰力發揮得淋漓盡致!

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #25
programme.desc: 烏野贏過稻荷崎,如願晉升第3場比賽,交戰對手為音駒高中。賭上各自長年夢想的 “垃圾場因緣對決” 即將展開!!

programme.title: 異世界藥局 #1
programme.desc: 世界頂級藥學家藥谷完治甦醒後,轉生成了宮廷藥師名門世家的次男,法馬・梅德西斯。他轉生後「神術」的能力隨之覺醒。家庭教師艾倫傳授他操控力量的方法,但法馬的神術之力遠非常人所能及。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #5
programme.desc: 「喵瘟」爆發後過了數月,世界已落入貓掌之中。文明崩壞,人類瀕臨滅亡的危機,宣告「貓咪末日」的到來。九那岐與小薰在追趕筒美的途中遇見了愛貓少年阿新。在他的引領下,兩人決定投靠一個名為文德爾施泰因的要塞。與此同時,一位叫做馬羅的男人也正在。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #6
programme.desc: 統領文德爾施泰因的愛貓領袖奶奶下令,讓超級愛貓的九那岐一行人前往商場,執行尋找下落不明夥伴的任務。與此同時,同樣愛貓的沃德親子檔,浩二、蓮及真樹,也為了籌措食物來到商場,卻陷入被可愛貓咪包圍,千鈞一髮的危險情況。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #7
programme.desc: 商場中個性鮮明又可愛的貓咪接連不斷地使出「陪我玩」攻擊,但其中卻有一隻特別不一樣的貓咪。那隻不知為何聽得懂人類語言的神祕貓咪,帶領九那岐一行人來到蓮及真樹的藏身之地。牠甚至表示要人類將自己帶回據點,一行人雖感到困惑,內心卻又興奮不已。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #8
programme.desc: 九那岐等人的愛貓小隊在完成物資籌備後,突然有一隻背上騎著貓的熊擋住了去路。但九那岐指出眼前的並不是熊,而是擁有驚人破壞力的貓。他自己也擺出貓咪架勢,就此展開「像人一樣的貓」與「像熊一樣的貓」之間的決鬥。而阿新與貓的「末日之戰」也隨之爆發。

programme.desc: 「喵瘟」爆發後過了數月,世界已落入貓掌之中。文明崩壞,人類瀕臨滅亡的危機,宣告「貓咪末日」的到來。九那岐與小薰在追趕筒美的途中遇見了愛貓少年阿新。在他的引領下,兩人決定投靠一個名為文德爾施泰因的要塞。與此同時,一位叫做馬羅的男人也正在。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #6
programme.desc: 統領文德爾施泰因的愛貓領袖奶奶下令,讓超級愛貓的九那岐一行人前往商場,執行尋找下落不明夥伴的任務。與此同時,同樣愛貓的沃德親子檔,浩二、蓮及真樹,也為了籌措食物來到商場,卻陷入被可愛貓咪包圍,千鈞一髮的危險情況。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #7
programme.desc: 商場中個性鮮明又可愛的貓咪接連不斷地使出「陪我玩」攻擊,但其中卻有一隻特別不一樣的貓咪。那隻不知為何聽得懂人類語言的神祕貓咪,帶領九那岐一行人來到蓮及真樹的藏身之地。牠甚至表示要人類將自己帶回據點,一行人雖感到困惑,內心卻又興奮不已。

programme.title: NYAIGHT OF THE LIVING CAT 活屍貓之夜 #8
programme.desc: 九那岐等人的愛貓小隊在完成物資籌備後,突然有一隻背上騎著貓的熊擋住了去路。但九那岐指出眼前的並不是熊,而是擁有驚人破壞力的貓。他自己也擺出貓咪架勢,就此展開「像人一樣的貓」與「像熊一樣的貓」之間的決鬥。而阿新與貓的「末日之戰」也隨之爆發。

programme.title: 月光下的異世界之旅 第二季 #12
programme.desc: 隨著夏天的結束,高地半獸人在探索森林時遭到狼和熊的攻擊。誠尋求平靜,但遇到的熊卻對他表現出敵意。

programme.title: 你是主角

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。n第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔

創世電視復興祭壇

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蘇穎睿牧師-信心之旅
programme.desc: 希伯來書除了論證耶穌基督的超越性之外,字裡行間隨時都有對猶太信徒的勸勉,因為這些猶太信徒受本族人的壓力,產生許多疑難,信心開始動搖。藉着希伯來書,蘇穎睿牧師帶你走進歷史,閱覽這趟考驗信心之旅。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.desc: 義前去跟進麻煩客人時，發現麻煩客是三妗婆。三妗婆強拉義等喝茶，期間行徑令人側目，更要求到高家過夜。三妗婆尖酸刻薄的說話令家中各人苦不堪言，眾人唯有迫義盡快完成保險計劃書，可是當義完成後，她卻失去蹤影！

阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 用檸檬烹調美食或可帶來驚喜！鼎爺選用青檸檬、鹹檸檬炮製「陳皮檸檬燉鴨」，汆水過後的鴨件與陳皮及檸檬同燉。趁燉湯的時間，鼎爺帶來「鹹檸檬浸黃腳鱲」。鼎爺有何方法令魚身受熱平均？水滾後下鹹檸、話梅、陳皮再下魚，想魚肉嫩滑留意竅門！灒油後灑上話梅蓉及青檸皮絲，味道更有層次。鼎爺自製滷水汁燜煮牛肋肉，利用餘溫浸焗令牛肋肉更入味。將原條牛肋肉蘸上粉漿炸至金黃香口，然後放涼切片，即成製法創新的「脆皮牛肋肉」。

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 中醫師提到，女性於分娩過程或導致氣血虧虛、筋骨大開、腎精虧損，因此坐月調理尤為重要。醫師細談坐月期間分階段調理的膳食重點，並介紹可舒緩產後情緒的穴位按壓方法。提升兒童軟實力有助增強專注力、執行功能、情緒管理。透過記憶遊戲、角色扮演，小朋友能於輕鬆氛圍下作訓練，「老師話」、「煮飯仔」均是合適的選擇。家長陪伴孩子玩遊戲時，有甚麼要注意？「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範一道「醬燒豬軟骨」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 香港據稱約有25%人符合強迫症的症狀，即全港約有近十八萬人有強迫症的思想或行為，情況值得關注。《醫度講》這次有何泳芍到來細談其疑似強迫症傾向，還有精神科醫生曹國柱為大家解構強迫症問題與相關迷思，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在本集提供可緩解強迫症症狀的食療和穴位，記得收看！

programme.title: 祕密的偶像公主粵日

東張西望粵
programme.desc: 北角某大廈住戶因樓上垃圾屋單位的漏水問題，投訴多時仍未解決，近日樓上住戶更弄爆鹹水管，令問題更嚴重？有合法寮屋戶主收到高額水費單，其後寮屋卻突然被承建商夷平用作渠務署施工通道，攝製隊分別聯繫渠務署、承建商、水務署要求回應。大律師就個案提供追討公道、損失的意見。陳展鵬、陳山聰、賴慰玲出席新節目宣傳活動，細談如何為下一代規劃未來。另帶來可改善「三高」的健康資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2803粵
programme.desc: 因某些緣故，尚善竟要提告城安；城安拒絕履行和解條件，母子將要對簿公堂。Joe亦遭人控告，天娥找大狀為他辯護並最終勝訴。城安眼見天娥竭力保護愛兒，與尚善形成強烈對比，本想與尚善「鬥到底」，但最終亦屈服認錯。城安羨慕Joe有天娥這樣的母親，刻意親近天娥以刺激尚善。尚善暗中阻撓，安排城安與Joe待在一起，怎料二人意外流落荒島，還面臨颱風來襲。天娥焦急萬分，尚善原本因某些理由並不擔心，詎料……

programme.title: I LOAN U 網上貸款平臺呈獻：重案解密#5粵PG
programme.desc: 友禾脅逼日安去殺馮妻，凱斌循各種線索鎖定日安有嫌疑，友禾目睹日安被凱斌帶走，凱斌推測友禾計劃搶子彈的地方，部署進行抓捕…小東獲準保釋，向凱斌解釋沒殺凱琳；桂芝失蹤，愛蓮找萬青幫忙，及後重案三接手此案。

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：成何體統#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 洛將軍斥責戶部發的軍糧摻了砂石，夏侯澹裝瘋，當庭斬殺戶部尚書。庾晚音到藏書閣查找應對旱災之策，沒想到端王聞風而來，話裡話外都在試探。庾晚音在太后宮中被嬪妃指責，夏侯澹突然出現，將誣陷她的嬪妃全部懲罰。

programme.title: 海馬牌牀褥呈獻：魔音女團粵
programme.desc: 初舞臺考覈下半場，檢視另外兩隊的訓練過程與演出成果。<最緊要快有甩頭髮的誘人亮點，隊長喬美莎要帶領莊子璇、陳熙蕊、葉靖儀喚出女人味，排練時竟壓力爆煲一度爆喊……熙蕊苦練高音部份，歌詞「仍然沒有方法達到 糟糕」卻似唱出心聲？<買得到講求高傲自信，隊長蔡華英偕廖慧儀、穎喬、李尹嫣上歌唱班時略欠「態度」，更被指是兒童合唱團？為了將勤補拙，四人也特意自學練舞，惟正式上堂始知練錯相反方向，浮現信心危機！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#23粵PG
programme.desc: 孝武與可人拍拖遇見孝貞，因仍念掛Joyce，故一直未向家人透露拍拖一事。國棟透過互聯網遍尋能冶療腿傷的方法，求神醫孫學林替其醫治，反而令傷勢加重。國棟恐要將腿切除，拒絕接受手術。國樑深宵到醫院求國棟原諒，國棟卻自責若與家人多溝通，不堅持己見，便不會釀成今日境況。簡潔接國棟電話，察覺他說話有異，連夜趕往醫院。國棟欲引火自焚，簡潔、楊光及可人至，楊光以陪國棟一齊死之方法勸服國棟放棄自殺。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 從太平山頂居高臨下，盡是香港繁華盛景。掌故專家鄭寶鴻登上山頂竟說要「搵老襯」，何出此言？「鹹魚就飯，鍋底刮爛」，一道「鹹魚蒸肉餅」成為多代港人的家常美食，且隨主持們前往鹹魚店舖訪尋「梅香」滋味。「老笠」、「派頭」等由外文演變而成的地道俗語，譯得㜺鬼又過癮！中文講師廖舜禧還解讀「唔食廣東米」的意思。師傅親手雕啄而成的手工麻雀，揉合香港文化與傳統工藝，主持嘗試照做，相信只會「麻雀追飛機－ 枉費心機」！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 所謂「單料銅煲，一滾就熟」，銅製家品盡顯精湛的手作工藝，並非新潮家品能夠比擬；且看銅器店主展示這種日漸失傳的民間絕學。廣東人常以「三隻手」借代小偷、竊匪，㜺鬼說法竟源於「看圖識字」？「烏龍」前身實是忠心護主的小狗，俗語「擺烏龍」又是否來自一場誤會？「食得禾米多」等不少俗語亦跟動物有關，留意今集講解。砧板做出來後便是「木魚命－ 捱打」，一塊優質砧板使用數十年依然堅固無比，製作過程有何祕密？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
香料密碼粵普
programme.desc: 從辣椒的火辣到肉豆蔻的辛香，從胡椒的辛辣到香草的芬芳，節目細膩呈現香料的個性與歷史，探討它們的特質，逐步揭開它們的神祕面紗，展現舌尖與香料交織的奇妙融合。

programme.title: 仨心友行 2粵
programme.desc: 諾懿為嘉欣、君馨和子羚親製健康早餐，誰知她們早已喫飽，完美錯過諾懿的心機。三女換上「下田」裝束，走進生態園仿熱帶雨林溫室，採摘玻璃屋餐廳會用到的葡萄、羅勒葉與茄子原食材。集齊食材後，她們要設計Cafe專屬餐單，諾懿放心讓三女下廚，豈料要兼任「洗碗男」！女主持合力炮製自家盛宴，漸漸培養出默契。入夜，她們滿心期待首次試菜，主打的「一口茄子批」卻臨門一腳失手？諾懿還相贈富心思的羅勒幼苗，為三人打打氣。

programme.title: 奇蹟小店粵
programme.desc: 面對疫情與加租夾擊，經營逾三十年的港式餅店無奈結業，幸遇奇蹟降臨，老闆夫婦在原舖旁重新開爐。招牌角仔藏感人故事，老闆娘回想為癌症病人達成臨終心願，感觸不已！製餅業勞心勞力，第二代傳人不怕辛苦，用心繼承父母心血。懷舊忌廉筒買少見少，有餅店老字號卻堅持用本地麵粉兼人手搓製。老闆由學徒做起，並接手餅店逾三十年，親切笑臉背後，其實肩負不少壓力，甚麼是他永不言退的動力？肥媽亦客串收銀員，感受濃厚街坊情。

programme.title: 週六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 過敏症是身體警號，也是免疫系統對致敏原所產生的防禦反應。谷主汛文提到對貓毛敏感，瀅仴則容易因環境引發皮膚過敏。凱文就「過敏症」主題作出資料蒐集，並為拍檔們帶來呼吸道、皮膚、食物的過敏相關資訊。如出現嚴重過敏反應，有機會危及生命安全，因此預防尤為重要。谷主們討論如何建立低敏感生活習慣，瀅仴提醒洗澡水溫度過高與熬夜都可能有影響，汛文則認為保持家居清潔是關鍵。此外，陪伴大家睡覺的毛公仔或是致敏元兇？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」瞭解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行II粵普
programme.desc: 節目由胡歌、劉濤和陳龍攜手中國國家地理融媒體中心主任張辰亮以及一眾新朋友，在節目中帶觀眾走進自然，走進科學研究員、環保愛好者和當地居民的生活工作。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 一男一女小朋友矇眼讓髮型師轉換髮型，其他孩子都讚賞二人的新造型，當事人脫下眼罩卻相視大笑！永城讓五位小朋友各自創作藝術畫，主題、用色、風格都大有不同。五幅作品會在藝廊展出，並請來專業藝術顧問與不同界別的人士評價、投票。雖然孩子們對自己的作品稍欠自信，但家長都對子女信心十足，最終票選結果如何？經歷三集的「美醜」課堂，有小朋友認識到內在美的重要性，也有人發現自己比想像中更愛美，還領略出活在當下的道理？

programme.title: 溜走的真味粵
programme.desc: 滷水鵝是不少人心目中的潮州代表菜式，並大多是選用體型龐大兼肉嫩多汁的獅頭鵝炮製。三位主持前往獅頭鵝養殖場，從源頭瞭解美味祕密，德哥順道分享揀鵝心得。與嘉賓薛家燕一同享用全鵝宴，奉客的頭盤「鵝掌凍」完全喫不到骨骼，原來是分子料理；「滷老鵝頭」，三姐稱口感像花膠！陳年滷水亦可充當火鍋湯底，烚煮鵝心等食材，別具風味。在鵝場旁，三姐就地取材烹調「涼瓜燜鵝掌翼」、「西紅茄鵝雜煮鵝蛋」等，端出最新鮮的真味。

programme.title: 地球大神祕粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神祕，我們會繼續從世界各地神祕事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 阿井即將被刪除，Delta向太晴求助，請他幫忙一起搭建元宇宙版磁浮鐵路館，讓阿井能在裡面工作。在伊奈和其他鐵路部成員相助下，元宇宙及時完成，但伊奈卻帶來壞消息，便是阿井程式太舊無法更新。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 手腳不協調的情況常常發生？跟隨兒童體適能教練「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，有助改善協調能力，還可順道提升平衡力。踢腳碰手、前後腳交替跳，可有難度？小朋友依照教練舉起不同顏色的色碟，做出深蹲、深蹲跳、平板支撐等指定動作，也能考驗反應與耐力。第二階段訓練，先手持氣球，輪流觸碰膝蓋和腳跟，節奏加快就可能會亂！單腳抬起，將氣球圍繞身體轉圈，然後手持氣球做開合跳，講求一定運動量，大家又能否應付得來？

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神祕怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧祕。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神祕怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧祕。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 家中的花槽長出了一些雜草。小丸子因為覺得雜草的花很美而拒捕將之清除。某天，小丸子的姐姐，爸爸，爺爺和嫲都不在家，只得小丸子與媽媽獨處。起初小丸子覺得很悶，但漸漸發現到一些平時沒有的樂趣。

programme.title: AI大講堂粵
programme.desc: 香港人工智能研發院董事局主席沈向洋教授多年來一直從事人工智能(AI)研究、開發及應用，他在節目中與主持人方健儀分享最早期的AI應用，令人印象最深是人類和電腦在西洋棋中的對弈。但隨著大數據成熟，大模型的出現，令AI有突破性發展，從科幻變成現實。沈教授提議市民可下載<<港話通、<<港法通等本地研發的AI產品，體驗AI帶來的便利。最後，沈教授還介紹了香港發展AI的優勢和人工智能研發院未來的工作。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 每逢假日，本港多個具生態價值的郊野景點迫滿遊客，露營熱點帳篷處處，同時衍生滋擾野生動物、亂拋垃圾等亂象，當局擬以試點形式在露營熱點引入預約及收費安排，能否遏止破壞行為？政府近年提出發展生態旅遊，在推動旅遊和保育之間，應該如何平衡及評估承載力？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：AI時代，未來實習生粵
programme.desc: 賴慰玲的八歲兒子也也，對一切有關飛機的都感興趣，更對飛機型號十分熟悉。廿年後，機師可會被AI取代？連媽媽也擔心過，卻提到會一直支持兒子追夢。也也獲安排在機長和慰玲的陪同下，駕駛價值二億的模擬器，機長更「準備」了突發情況，也也亦冷靜完成飛行任務！另一日，也也要「撇下」媽媽並於機長指導下操控真小型飛機，從容飛一轉後，機長對其表現有何評價？隨後，一段以也也做主角，由AI生成的成長片段，還讓慰玲感動落淚。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！近期獲頒「最佳原創電影歌曲」獎項的歌手黃淑蔓接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 《魔音女團》其中十五位練習生唱出<下一站天后，四隊玩「看圖估歌仔」遊戲，結果如何？梁釗峯接受半月板手術後，萌生新歌<半月辦好概念，並要將歌曲送給愛逞強之人？吳欣彤以快歌<Starlight，寄語大家無需拘束隨心而行。女團Honey Punch主打跳唱，初試唱情歌<樓上的姐姐，遇到甚麼困難？本集另會倒數「勁歌金榜」二十位排名，張德蘭亦受訪，訴說將於紅館開個唱紀念入行60年的緣份。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 在黑龍江的冰天雪地中，將散養的土雞配以風乾草菇煮成小雞燉蘑菇，是當地民眾的立冬美食。非洲的納米比亞人亦會將雞隻放養，因運動量大被稱為「馬拉松雞」。肉質獨特，僅以簡單烹調就滋味非常。韓國大邱的市民則會將糯米、紅棗等釀入雞隻中燉煮，製成夏日補身妙品人參雞湯。炸雞於當地亦深受歡迎，男女老少皆愛喫。安徽的黃淮地區，雞絲湯是普及早點之一。另有著名的符離集燒雞，滷製後雞皮甘香誘人，成為地方代表菜餚。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 一百米跑香港紀錄保持者葉景維、二百米跑代表梁靖恆分別榮膺田總公開組與青年組的最佳男子運動員，兩飛人分享得獎感受與短跑心得。香港首次舉辦國際瑜伽體式運動比賽，瑜伽達人講述賽制形式。三位本地運動員細談賽艇的意義，堅持、紀律都是要點。五人冰球賽青少年組結束，搜羅不同組別的決賽精華。短道速滑女將林靜欣早前出戰冬奧以第七名完賽，獲頒發獎金作表揚。另送上世界女排聯賽香港站記招、本地帆船賽與學界合球賽花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
疊影狙擊#21粵PG
programme.desc: 雄透露曦就是金夫人，並且證實晨是警察臥底的真相，諾震驚不已；晨表示現在只向錢看，但諾不信，要求她對付晟傑來表示誠意；晨和諾拷問龍少，要他說出金夫人的祕密，龍少透露曦偷了傑的犯罪證據，因此二人反目成仇…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 一男一女小朋友矇眼讓髮型師轉換髮型，其他孩子都讚賞二人的新造型，當事人脫下眼罩卻相視大笑！永城讓五位小朋友各自創作藝術畫，主題、用色、風格都大有不同。五幅作品會在藝廊展出，並請來專業藝術顧問與不同界別的人士評價、投票。雖然孩子們對自己的作品稍欠自信，但家長都對子女信心十足，最終票選結果如何？經歷三集的「美醜」課堂，有小朋友認識到內在美的重要性，也有人發現自己比想像中更愛美，還領略出活在當下的道理？

programme.title: 溜走的真味粵
programme.desc: 滷水鵝是不少人心目中的潮州代表菜式，並大多是選用體型龐大兼肉嫩多汁的獅頭鵝炮製。三位主持前往獅頭鵝養殖場，從源頭瞭解美味祕密，德哥順道分享揀鵝心得。與嘉賓薛家燕一同享用全鵝宴，奉客的頭盤「鵝掌凍」完全喫不到骨骼，原來是分子料理；「滷老鵝頭」，三姐稱口感像花膠！陳年滷水亦可充當火鍋湯底，烚煮鵝心等食材，別具風味。在鵝場旁，三姐就地取材烹調「涼瓜燜鵝掌翼」、「西紅茄鵝雜煮鵝蛋」等，端出最新鮮的真味。

programme.title: 香料密碼粵普
programme.desc: 從辣椒的火辣到肉豆蔻的辛香，從胡椒的辛辣到香草的芬芳，節目細膩呈現香料的個性與歷史，探討它們的特質，逐步揭開它們的神祕面紗，展現舌尖與香料交織的奇妙融合。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 從太平山頂居高臨下，盡是香港繁華盛景。掌故專家鄭寶鴻登上山頂竟說要「搵老襯」，何出此言？「鹹魚就飯，鍋底刮爛」，一道「鹹魚蒸肉餅」成為多代港人的家常美食，且隨主持們前往鹹魚店舖訪尋「梅香」滋味。「老笠」、「派頭」等由外文演變而成的地道俗語，譯得㜺鬼又過癮！中文講師廖舜禧還解讀「唔食廣東米」的意思。師傅親手雕啄而成的手工麻雀，揉合香港文化與傳統工藝，主持嘗試照做，相信只會「麻雀追飛機－ 枉費心機」！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 所謂「單料銅煲，一滾就熟」，銅製家品盡顯精湛的手作工藝，並非新潮家品能夠比擬；且看銅器店主展示這種日漸失傳的民間絕學。廣東人常以「三隻手」借代小偷、竊匪，㜺鬼說法竟源於「看圖識字」？「烏龍」前身實是忠心護主的小狗，俗語「擺烏龍」又是否來自一場誤會？「食得禾米多」等不少俗語亦跟動物有關，留意今集講解。砧板做出來後便是「木魚命－ 捱打」，一塊優質砧板使用數十年依然堅固無比，製作過程有何祕密？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 洪天明與周家蔚因一碟豬腩肉結緣？二人在Do姐面前炫耀恩愛，家蔚還製造打和賽果，務求與天明享用矜貴海膽煲仔飯，令農夫幾乎「翻檯」！祕魯能塗抹傷口的龍血汁取自何處？東京以醫院為主題的餐廳用甚麼盛載啤酒？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 見識過東京神乎其技柴犬手工糖、臺北文房四寶甜品、泰國重量級海南雞飯，嘉賓周柏豪、連詩雅即不停反問，而林德信表現沉默，卻不停重複着三個字，令Do姐不知如何是好！陸永又為何打定輸數，認定與花膠扒無緣？

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，瞭解最偉大科學家的生活，瞭解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 隨著新店舖開張，星夢頻道樂園的奇幻旋律區熱鬧非常，未來等人今天也到此一遊。另一方面，閃亮CHU為能夠再變成偶像姿態，向同為吉祥物的玫露熊求助。而奇蹟閃耀組則為了閃亮CHU，打算設計一套原創造型送給她。

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 奶龍與小七之大戰暴暴龍粵普
programme.desc: 在一個山清水秀的村子裡，奶龍小七平靜的生活被打破，暴暴龍為了取代奶龍成為宇宙最強龍，在村子各種使壞，奶龍小七為了阻止其的惡行展開一系列英勇鬥爭，上演了一幕幕只為能守每個人心中最純真的美好。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄整天遲到，多啦A夢於是拿出「按鈕門」，讓大雄的房門可以直接連到課室。大雄和多啦A夢因為地租上升而被扣減零用錢，他們亂聊一通如何製造土地之際，多啦A夢忽然想到可以建造一個無人島。

programme.title: 少女煮意日常粵日
programme.desc: 隨著真子與飲食文化研究會的成員日漸親近，詩音便提議週末大家一起外出遊玩。但來到翌日，詩音卻哭訴自己的私己錢不見了，沒錢就沒法跟大家玩。於是大家來到詩音的家，找出私己錢的下落……

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 溫哥華可以怎樣玩？「地膽」陳婉衡教自由行一族搭鐵路最方便！固蘭島市集齊集各式地道食材與熟食，除了必喫「酥皮周打蜆湯」，婉衡還會閒坐岸邊品嚐人氣冬甩，超寫意！海景早餐店深受追捧，鴨腿配窩夫等特色料理，滋味如何？大型美術用品店出售多元化的畫畫、勞作、工藝材料，絕對是藝術愛好者的購物天堂！下午茶時間，婉衡走進海鮮餐廳，盡情享用新鮮生蠔、足料龍蝦包，好滿足。緊接一試酒精啫喱、無酒精的啤酒，見識當地夜生活。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 元朗新田擁有獨特的環境和水質，因而孕育出肉質肥美鮮甜的黃油烏頭。肥媽今集示範冷、熱烏頭菜式，體現本地漁場風味。冷盤「潮州凍烏頭」用料簡單���配上普寧豆醬即可成為清涼醒胃的夏日菜式。熱葷「香茅鹽焗烏頭」配以自製酸汁享用，箇中非凡惹味，連肥媽亦不禁讚嘆！冬瓜具有袪濕解熱功效，肥媽選用加拿大熟龍蝦，巧製「瑤柱海鮮冬瓜環」。另一道「茶香豬」用上紅茶、味醂、蠔油做湯底，創意配搭又會帶來甚麼美味驚喜？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 花錦鱔堪稱「鱔中之王」，是矜貴的養生食材，漁場負責人還指一年四季皆可喫之進補！肥媽採用斤両十足的花錦鱔炮製「中西四喫」，並細談「鱔稿」典故。魚頭、魚尾配上天麻、白芷、川芎燉湯，即成滋補的「女性恩物」！踏入立夏，運用荷葉烹調有助清熱、袪濕。阿媽以荷葉裹着鱔件、紅棗、白玉木耳，蒸出清新口味。「煎封花錦鱔腩扒」肉質脆口，魚皮還有花膠般的口感？而西式的「意大利香草燴花錦鱔」味道嶄新，更是阿媽和6號的首選！

programme.title: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖!粵
programme.desc: 第二組藝人家庭準備入學，單是一條爸媽二選一題目，「小乖乖」林以晴已令喊包爸爸林子善失守……媽媽董佩欣反映子善對小乖乖稍稍過分保護，但提到允許女兒拍拖、結婚生仔的歲數，子善反而較太太鬆手？家長要於適當時候學懂放手，纔可讓子女快速成長！諾懿要子善半小時不能放低小乖乖，並執行各項刺激任務。抱住女兒玩「過山車」、平板支撐、行樓梯、投籃，全程黐到實，子善有何體會？向媽媽示愛時間，父女齊齊表愛意，場面有洋蔥！

programme.title: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖!粵
programme.desc: 子善的女兒「小乖乖」似乎黐爸爸多過黐媽媽，但這集的素人爸爸，卻與兩名女兒妃頤、玥玥的關係相對較疏離，兩組家庭相遇會擦出甚麼火花？午飯期間要教餐桌禮儀，雙方表現如何大不同？兩位爸爸首次替愛女扮靚變身「小公主」，化妝、紮辮、換衫做到足。輪到女兒惡搞爸爸，有趣得來亦甚溫馨！接着寫信給廿年後的女兒，子善讀出一字一句，好感人。對於兩位爸爸的湊女表現，暗中監視的媽媽們可會滿意？片尾還有神祕小驚喜，感動升級！

programme.title: 非洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 印度洋珍珠三島之旅來到第三站毛裏裘斯，歎完早餐即往野生動物園，和斑馬、長頸鹿近距離接觸。芷珮更參加長達45分鐘與獅子漫步的成人團，為何撫摸獅子必定要夠大力？逾百年歷史的毛裏裘斯製餅廠，仍然使用棕櫚樹葉生火，員工的「耐熱」程度亦令人佩服。幾款味道的餅乾與夾心餅，哪款是芷珮一家推介？在首都路易士港隨本土團四處遊覽，喫盡捲餅、香蕉撻、菠蘿片等美食，當地有何獨特喫法？但似乎芷珮的味蕾不盡認同毛裏裘斯人……

programme.title: 非洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 繼續毛裏裘斯的自然遊，想與海豚鬥游泳？且坐船出海，由船長及天意決定可有這種緣分！即使無緣，仍有水上購物景點、浮潛勝域，尋找買玩樂趣。芷珮進駐的渡假村，房間有露臺作賣點外，也可免費玩滑水，而且提供一對一貼心教學。她還偕家人以十分鐘船程往私人小島，入住圓形透明酒店房，等着日落再靜待晚間看星。毛裏裘斯以出產蔗糖聞名，芷珮到訪博物館瞭解相關歷史；再參觀自行種植甘蔗的冧酒工廠，並在附設餐廳細味冧酒饗宴。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 陳瀅(Jeannie)曾於加拿大留學，早在中學時修讀過甜品製作課程，她甚至在母親節為婆婆親手製作愛心曲奇，但當年卻為她帶來重大挫折。有見及此，「甜品達人」古嘉俊教Jeannie創製一款別出心裁的「檸檬芒果朱古力棉花棒棒糖」，為她洗脫不快回憶。甜甜的棉花糖加入帶酸的檸檬汁及芒果蓉，口味更豐富，趣緻卡通造型更必然深得小朋友歡心。Jeannie樣子甜美，佻皮鬼馬的性格更逗得阿古哭笑不得，所為何事？

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 京都指揮室的候任駕駛員西大路大和因適性值不足而無法作戰，太晴三人與天奉命前往支援。大和熱愛機械人，希望駕駛新幹線戰士守衛和平，卻因為以前一次遭不良少年圍毆，令他對戰鬥產生陰影。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 適逢母親節，小朋友齊聚「My Little Show」舞臺歌頌母愛。逾十人合唱團帶來<Little Love，歌聲溫暖動人；另有女生獨唱<Lavender’s Blue，清婉柔美。主持姐姐亦會與結他導師一同唱歌，將<媽媽帶我去搭叮叮和<媽媽I Love You，獻給各位偉大的母親。彤彤姐姐也憶述童年搭電車時邊玩「捉怪獸」遊戲的樂趣；Tiffany姐姐還分享跟媽媽一起瞞着爸爸的兒時小祕密。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 學校的老師家要來家訪。媽媽為了不失禮，把家中可見之處都打掃得乾乾淨淨，並下令小丸子整理好自己的房間。媽媽為姐姐聘請了一位補習老師。小丸子知道之後，對補習老師充滿好奇。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近期市場多了不少數以億元成交的商廈大手買賣，這個現象對本地經濟走勢有甚麼啟示？人工智能在各行各業有不同的應用，其中金融業的應用場景如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 為母則強，為母則剛，為了子女往往激發出母親強韌意志。但有些媽媽，打理自己家庭之餘，更將母愛分享予其他小朋友，協助有需要的媽媽，她們背後有何故事呢？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」瞭解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港何濟公止痛退熱散呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 一連兩集，十八強參賽者將帶來各自的「人生之歌」。登場前，選手要揀選挑戰「進取之路」還是踏上「平實之路」。「進取之路」只需獲得89分或以上即可直接晉級；「平實之路」則要與其他對手舉行排位戰，分數最高四人方能確保出線，而評判們會於未知選手選擇哪條角逐之路的情況下，作出評分。

programme.title: 一週星星粵
programme.desc: 鄭國江筆下寫過逾二千首的廣東歌詞，趁入行55週年舉行作品音樂會，DJ周國豐以「真善美」概括其詞作，而區瑞強亦演唱幾首經典，包括<信、<漣漪。鄭老師最多合作的歌手是林子祥，只因後者起身起得早？寫給徐小鳳的作品大多一稿過，<逍遙四方卻是例外？國豐聽過一個傳聞要八卦，<漣漪究竟是否陳百強要憑歌傳情之作？主持許文軒稱鄭老師是最早期的「斜槓族」，同時教書又填詞，學生黃宗澤竟鬥膽揭鄭老師是一位惡老師？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 星廚莫燦霖帶波波品嚐水上人家的風味佳餚，包括足料湯水、煎自家製鹹鮮黃花魚及原隻龍蝦米線，鮮味十足！荃灣地膽Ryan推介區內的「人氣」米線店，必試炸醬、腩肉與蘿蔔小鍋米線，惹味之選。居港泰國人帶黃嘉雯造訪九龍城一間由泰國華僑經營的餐廳，食材直送自泰國，二人細嚐泰式燒牛肉、辣椒蒜蓉炒青口，食材正宗，味道貼近本地人口味。蕭欣浩博士與行仔走訪一間老字號燒臘店，品嚐炭燒乳豬與蜜汁叉燒之餘，並細說燒味典故。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
疊影狙擊#22粵PG
programme.desc: 晟傑和飛飛對曉晨的行徑感到困惑，還懷疑她是否人格分裂。曉晨幫文諾以金夫人身分吸引各地用家參與文諾的地下金庫計劃；但俊傑毫不畏懼，似乎有所打算…飛飛終於打通那電話號碼，聽筒傳來熟悉的嗓音，不久便遭滅口…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖!粵
programme.desc: 第二組藝人家庭準備入學，單是一條爸媽二選一題目，「小乖乖」林以晴已令喊包爸爸林子善失守……媽媽董佩欣反映子善對小乖乖稍稍過分保護，但提到允許女兒拍拖、結婚生仔的歲數，子善反而較太太鬆手？家長要於適當時候學懂放手，纔可讓子女快速成長！諾懿要子善半小時不能放低小乖乖，並執行各項刺激任務。抱住女兒玩「過山車」、平板支撐、行樓梯、投籃，全程黐到實，子善有何體會？向媽媽示愛時間，父女齊齊表愛意，場面有洋蔥！

programme.title: 爸知弊! 你嚟湊吖!粵
programme.desc: 子善的女兒「小乖乖」似乎黐爸爸多過黐媽媽，但這集的素人爸爸，卻與兩名女兒妃頤、玥玥的關係相對較疏離，兩組家庭相遇會擦出甚麼火花？午飯期間要教餐桌禮儀，雙方表現如何大不同？兩位爸爸首次替愛女扮靚變身「小公主」，化妝、紮辮、換衫做到足。輪到女兒惡搞爸爸，有趣得來亦甚溫馨！接着寫信給廿年後的女兒，子善讀出一字一句，好感人。對於兩位爸爸的湊女表現，暗中監視的媽媽們可會滿意？片尾還有神祕小驚喜，感動升級！

programme.title: 非洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 梁芷珮和家人經新加坡轉機，首站未達非洲範圍，先抵「渡假天堂」馬爾代夫！芷珮預訂的渡假屋，位於水上，出門走幾步樓梯即可投進淺海浮潛。重點是租金包三餐，酒水亦隨意飲個夠本，隨教練前往團體浮潛都是免費。近海自然食海鮮，沙灘上享用海鮮晚餐，無調味亦夠美味！魚從何來？芷珮帶子女出海，體驗馬爾代夫漁民的傳統開住船釣魚法，最終有多少漁獲？淺水浮潛哪會足夠？芷珮還包船、包島玩浮潛、食海鮮，並於水中跟鯊魚見一面！

programme.title: 非洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 塞舌爾島是非洲收入較高的島國，曾被法國統治。芷珮一行人經杜拜轉機來到，先往當地的市場，看看有什麼手工藝品可當手信，收穫不少！與首站馬爾代夫相若，芷珮預訂的渡假村套房都是食、住、玩全包，帶小朋友到訪亦不成問題，因有兒童營地。免費出海玩帆船與親子槳板，隨意跳進水中爽一番！當地亦有不少本地團，眾人隨團坐觀光船，欣賞海底魚類暢泳，再登上只有一人居住的小島，探訪龐大的陸龜，還伸手撫摸，摸龜殼原來會觸動神經？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 陳瀅(Jeannie)曾於加拿大留學，早在中學時修讀過甜品製作課程，她甚至在母親節為婆婆親手製作愛心曲奇，但當年卻為她帶來重大挫折。有見及此，「甜品達人」古嘉俊教Jeannie創製一款別出心裁的「檸檬芒果朱古力棉花棒棒糖」，為她洗脫不快回憶。甜甜的棉花糖加入帶酸的檸檬汁及芒果蓉，口味更豐富，趣緻卡通造型更必然深得小朋友歡心。Jeannie樣子甜美，佻皮鬼馬的性格更逗得阿古哭笑不得，所為何事？

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 溫哥華可以怎樣玩？「地膽」陳婉衡教自由行一族搭鐵路最方便！固蘭島市集齊集各式地道食材與熟食，除了必喫「酥皮周打蜆湯」，婉衡還會閒坐岸邊品嚐人氣冬甩，超寫意！海景早餐店深受追捧，鴨腿配窩夫等特色料理，滋味如何？大型美術用品店出售多元化的畫畫、勞作、工藝材料，絕對是藝術愛好者的購物天堂！下午茶時間，婉衡走進海鮮餐廳，盡情享用新鮮生蠔、足料龍蝦包，好滿足。緊接一試酒精啫喱、無酒精的啤酒，見識當地夜生活。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 元朗新田擁有獨特的環境和水質，因而孕育出肉質肥美鮮甜的黃油烏頭。肥媽今集示範冷、熱烏頭菜式，體現本地漁場風味。冷盤「潮州凍烏頭」用料簡單，配上普寧豆醬即可成為清涼醒胃的夏日菜式。熱葷「香茅鹽焗烏頭」配以自製酸汁享用，箇中非凡惹味，連肥媽亦不禁讚嘆！冬瓜具有袪濕解熱功效，肥媽選用加拿大熟龍蝦，巧製「瑤柱海鮮冬瓜環」。另一道「茶香豬」用上紅茶、味醂、蠔油做湯底，創意配搭又會帶來甚麼美味驚喜？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 花錦鱔堪稱「鱔中之王」，是矜貴的養生食材，漁場負責人還指一年四季皆可喫之進補！肥媽採用斤両十足的花錦鱔炮製「中西四喫」，並細談「鱔稿」典故。魚頭、魚尾配上天麻、白芷、川芎燉湯，即成滋補的「女性恩物」！踏入立夏，運用荷葉烹調有助清熱、袪濕。阿媽以荷葉裹着鱔件、紅棗、白玉木耳，蒸出清新口味。「煎封花錦鱔腩扒」肉質脆口，魚皮還有花膠般的口感？而西式的「意大利香草燴花錦鱔」味道嶄新，更是阿媽和6號的首選！

programme.title: 打死不離父子兵粵英
programme.desc: 畢德利和巴尼再次踏上另一場史詩般的冒險之旅，向著東方的日本和泰國進發!

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，瞭解最偉大科學家的生活，瞭解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼羣守護者路卡、熊羣保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾羣守護者提傑，以及貓羣守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫樸正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴(完)
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫樸一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子樸言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而樸言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫樸一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子樸言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而樸言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫樸正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是隻能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的祕密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 人氣封鎖中:UserNotFound(完)
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同時作為轉學生的機率，是旼財意想不到的巧合。與作為人氣女王敏在協議交換身份生活，原本逐漸透明的生活開始畫上色彩。隨著時間害怕被拆穿，同時只在敏在面前直率的申義俊，在他的陪伴與守護找到自我。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S1
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S1
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的巖漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫樸正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫樸一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子樸言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而樸言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫樸正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是隻能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的祕密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Submarino
programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

While overseeing renovations to her beach house in 1970s Chile, Carmen’s quiet life is upended when a priest asks her to hide a wounded fugitive. As she steps beyond her quiet life, Carmen is pulled into the undercurrents of a politically tumultuous Chile.

programme.title: All For Diego
programme.desc: Pablo and Diego are two brothers working as dishwashers at a bar while playing soccer in the afternoons. After Diego falls victim to a hit and run, Pablo enters into a soccer tournament in order to pay for the surgeries needed to keep his brother alive.

programme.title: A Butterfly's Heart
programme.desc: Juozapas is a quiet boy who cultivates insects in an abandoned house. He has a big bulge under his weird sweater and the school’s tough kids call him “balloon”. Rugilè moves to town and becomes Juozapas’ friend. She is the first to discover his secret.

programme.title: American Skin
programme.desc: Lincoln Jefferson, an Iraqi War veteran, working as a school janitor tries to mend his relationship with his son after a divorce. When his son is killed by a police officer found innocent without standing trial, he takes matters into his own hands.

programme.title: Joy Of Fatherhood

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices it's clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Stick Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels prepare for a campfire by collecting sticks of all sizes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book. The Squirrels want to have a go too.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Irrigation
programme.desc: Uh oh! Glitch accidently uses his size-ray to shrink the Go Jetters and Ubercorn so that they are the size of ants!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bishop Rock Lighthouse, Isles of Scilly
programme.desc: Glitch plunges the sea into darkness in a night-time adventure near the Isles of Scilly.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Thomas and the Forest Engines
programme.desc: In Brazil, Thomas meets two wood-burning engines who've never travelled beyond their eucalyptus railway.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Star Renovation
programme.desc: Venus has attempted to redecorate the night sky, but now Sarah can't find any of her favourite constellations...

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Woolly Memories
programme.desc: Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Flower
programme.desc: Fifi asks Stanley to help her find a new place for her friend Isabelle the Sun-bell Daisy. This proves trickier than initially planned as Isabelle has some specific needs.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Den
programme.desc: Little Woo and Seamus call Stanley to help them build a den so they can watch the bugs in the forest without disturbing them. Stanley builds a giant, camouflaged den on legs.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - My Grandad Sometimes Steals My Chocolate Buttons
programme.desc: From tickles and piggybacks to no longer being able to do cartwheels, grandparents are brilliant!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time for carnival
programme.desc: JoJo wants to celebrate the St Lucia carnival with Great Gran Gran, but it's too far away to travel to! Instead, JoJo and Gran Gran have their own carnival in the garden!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Pen Pal Badge
programme.desc: Duggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Being Quiet Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - The Salmon Run, Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska's a cool place to watch the salmon run, but Glitch opens a 'fishy taxi service' to help the salmon avoid tricky waterfalls and greedy bears. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Festive Special
programme.desc: Carrot, Potato, Parsnip and Brussels Sprout perform the festive classic Auld Lang Syne.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Pak Choi
programme.desc: Pak Choi, who might be known by many names, sings about how she's "Always Pak To You!"

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Desserts of Destiny
programme.desc: Evil Pea lures Supertato and Tomato into her cave of frosted doom. Can they find the courage to avoid her traps and retrieve The Lost Candle of Birthdays for Tomato's Museum?

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Tato Tower Sleepover

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Fairy Tale

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.desc: Percy causes confusion for everyone and prompts delays, when he spends too much time panicking over nothing.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Bottom Bump
programme.desc: The Teletubbies bottom bounce on The Tubby Bouncy before wiggling their bottoms to a special bottom bump song.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperor's daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor's tomb.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang's masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the "sick people of Asia" and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters &amp;amp; recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma's pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours

What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: The Grandmaster

Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey

Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Bad Omen
programme.desc: When Omen hijacks the Mothership and Royal Cores, all seems lost for our heroes. The Royal heirs are able to defeat the killer Blank, but at a high cost.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Moving Day
programme.desc: After last season’s victory, Aja and Krel struggle to relocate Mothership back to their Arcadia Oaks neighborhood, but their task is complicated when Toby and Eli discover the Royals’ Akiridion secret.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Moonlight Run
programme.desc: Aja and Krel hitch a ride in Stuart’s old UFO on a mission to rescue Vex from a bounty hunter outpost on the Moon. Meanwhile, Zadra receives intel about Morando from a surprising new ally.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S2 - Treasure Of The Sierra MartyBig Baby
programme.desc: Chet, Skidmark and Smoove Move bring swamp toad Marty on an adventure; The snails fumble taking care of a lost human child left at the taco stand.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S2 - Turboldy Go Part 1Part 2
programme.desc: A mix-up puts the FAST crew on a rocket bound for outer space; The crew must work together to avoid space madness, debris ... and a fiery re-entry.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Egg's Day Out The Way of the Snake
programme.desc: Archibald takes care of a lost egg for the day. But when the egg starts to crack, Archibald has to get the egg back to its parents. After Archibald’s arms fall asleep, he joins a dojo ran by snakes and embraces a life without appendages.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Castles and Caves
programme.desc: Archibald and his siblings embark on a quest in a Castles and Caves adventure game. As the Strutters delve into the fantasy realm, they realize that Archibald’s unusual choices will make the quest even more challenging. Archibald and his siblings continue on their Castles and Caves adventure game. When they face off against the witch, they have to trust Archibald’s unique approach to hopefully win the game.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales S3 - The Healing Tree
programme.desc: While riding back to Miradero, the girls get lost -- and Abigail's horse gets bitten by a snake! Can an old friend's skills help save the day?

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - The Journey
programme.desc: A paladinis trapped in a distant Galra outpost

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Amazing Donna Bye, Bye Boardie
programme.desc: When Donna decides to show off her not-so-flashy skills as a magician at the Community Center talent show, the Zenkos must do everything they can to save her act from becoming an embarrassing disaster. After Sam’s favorite skateboard accidentally gets put in with donations Mr. Tanaka is collecting for a fundraiser, the team is led on a merry chase as the skateboard passes from one Harmony Harbor denizen to another.

programme.title: Veggietales: In The House S2 - Glued At The Hip The Action Figure
programme.desc: Larry takes a verse seriously and glues himself to BobBob, Larry, Jimmy, and Jerry gather their money to buy a Thunderlion Ultraveggie action figure

programme.title: Veggietales: In The House S2 - The Lost Tooth The Companion Ship
programme.desc: Larry loses his only tooth so Madame Clueberry tries to help find itBob and Larry build a fishing boat but it leaks and Motato wants to overtake it

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Salty and Sweet Cruz Blues
programme.desc: Chef J tells Ollie he cooks with love. Kelp and Ollie set out to make food with love for him. When various food combos fail, Ollie considers giving up, because it isn’t good enough. Kelp goes to his Dad for answers, and two seemingly different ingredients form something magical. When Cruz is not his usual upbeat self, Kelp tries various ways to cheer him up before realizing the best way to be a good friend is to just sit with him, and let him feel what he’s feeling.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Pet Sitters Narwhalicorn Day
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop pet-sit Crabby, who acts out until they realize he’s missing home. Kelp feels like he can’t choose between a celebration on land or under the sea. So he attempts to do both... at the same time!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cupcake Tree
programme.desc: When the Gabby Cats get stuck in the leaves of an overgrown cupcake tree, it's up to Gabby, Pandy and cupcake-expert Cakey to work together to shrink the overgrown cupcake tree branch by branch--and to save CatRat from where he's stuck at the top! For our COTD segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - The Fairy Festival!
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Crash Course
programme.desc: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Furious Fun
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders have a "Dragon Day" to show their skills to a young fan, but Aggro skips it to hang out with her new fun -- but reckless -- friends.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lula's Last Stand Triple Trouble
programme.desc: Little Lula has set up a lemonade stand, but she’s not getting any business. The Zenkos swing into action to send customers her way. When Donna, Fawna and Rona have a spat, the triplets’ longstanding annual tradition of viewing a comet together is in jeopardy. Now it’s up to Team Zenko to get the three feuding sisters back together again before the comet streaks by.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
